label: Safety Threshold Breach — Line1 Vibration Spike
description: M12 and M27 both cross the critical vibration threshold simultaneously (shared conveyor coupling issue), triggering a Line1-wide safety hold rather than a single-machine repair. This scenario centers the Safety agent instead of Procurement.
